notes: Fixed: dragging the seek bar (Podcasts, Music, expanded Now Playing) no longer sends a live seek on every drag pixel - it now seeks once, on release, for smoother scrubbing. Improved: TalkBack now correctly announces on/off for every switch in Settings, Sound Effects, and the category-visibility dialog; Podcasts' Genre filter is now a one-tap row like Dashboard and Music's category filters instead of opening a separate sheet.
